articles.title: Amazon is complaining about NYC Council on shipping labels, too
articles.essence: Amazon is leaving no venue unexplored in its fight against the New York City Council and the Delivery Protection Act. The company is now putting labels on shipments claiming that the Council could add up to $5 to any Amazon order.

articles.title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
articles.essence: One of the items on the agenda for UN diplomats meeting in Geneva this week was working towards rules regarding the use of autonomous weapons, or so-called "killer robots." articles.title: John Roberts, the voice of Linda Belcher, is just happy to finish a thing
articles.essence: You probably know John Roberts best as the voice of Linda Belcher on Bob's Burgers. The show just wrapped up its 16th season and shows no signs of slowing down anytime soon.
articles.full_body: You probably know John Roberts best as the voice of Linda Belcher on Bob's Burgers. The show just wrapped up its 16th season and shows no signs of slowing down anytime soon. The show remains a reliable source of laughs, top-notch puns, and frankly wholesome fun. Comedy is just part of Roberts' life, however.
